critical_code_review_comments: chat/[id].tsx is still 1717 lines (>700 line guideline) — future refactor to split composer/upload/knowledge sub-features would help avoid another silent-drop bug on the DocumentPicker asset shape.

uploadAsset's .zip branch surfaces failures via Alert.alert on the knowledge-source POST but NOT if uploadZipChunked itself throws (e.g., init 5xx or a PUT part failure) — the outer try/catch just logs 'Upload failed'. Consider a more specific 'Indexing failed' alert for the zip path so users don't silently see a missing chip if the archive is too large or the backend is down.
